d:
花坞夫人攥紧他的手腕，
指甲几近嵌入皮肉，
眼眸中燃烧着炽热且疯狂的占有欲。
“从见你的第一眼起，
你就只能是我的。
这园子是你的牢笼，
我是你的狱卒，
生也好，死也罢，
你永远别想挣脱。”
彼之良·曼陀罗 【花坞夫人/仿生2.2L系列/160MODcm】

Madam Floral Soiree clutches his wrist,
her nails nearly embedding in his flesh,
her eyes burning with hot, crazed possessiveness.
"From the first moment I saw you,
you can only be mine."
"The garden is your cage.
I am your jailer,
in life or in death,
you will never be free."
Bezlya Mandragora MadamFloralSoirée, Bionic 2.2 L series 160cm MOD ver
